title: Air quality
underWho: Within the WHO 24-hour guideline of 15 μg/m³.
fcAlert: {day}: PM2.5 is forecast to reach {pm}. Plan errands and exercise for the cleaner hours.
fcA11y: PM2.5 forecast for the next {n} days, peaking at {pm} on {day}
sensSub: Child, older adult, heart or lung condition · stored only on this phone
lead: Protection first. Follow your doctor’s advice on high days.
sensorsSub: {count, plural, one {{n} of your own PM2.5 devices} other {{n} of your own PM2.5 devices}}
noSensorsSub: Connect a PM2.5 sensor to compare your street with the area.
devSub: {count, plural, =0 {No sensors} one {{n} sensor} other {{n} sensors}}
guestDevices: Sensors are saved to your Atmos X account.
placeNote: Outdoors at 1.5–3 m, shaded, inlet facing down, away from kitchen vents, generators, AC outflow and the road edge.
privNote: Your pin stays private. The public map snaps to the zone and hides your name.
outNote: Outdoor sensors that pass the 7-day check join the area map with a community badge.
inNote: Indoor sensors never go public — they power your indoor vs outdoor advice.
q1: Is it shaded from direct sun?
q2: Is it at least 2 m from a kitchen vent, generator or AC outflow?
q3: Is the inlet facing down with free airflow?

esp32.name: ESP32 custom node
esp32.parts: ESP32 · Plantower PMS5003 · BME280 or SHT31
esp32.best: Full control; your own firmware posts to Atmos X

sc.name: Sensor.Community kit
sc.best: Fastest setup; sends to Sensor.Community and Atmos X at once

purple.name: PurpleAir unit
purple.best: No building; read through the PurpleAir API · costs more

realNote: Your sensor sends its own PM2.5 readings with a private token. Readings older than 6 hours show the device as offline.
tokenOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Anyone with it can send readings as this sensor.
curlNote: Send at most one reading per minute. PM2.5 in µg/m³ (0–1000); pm10, temp_c and rh are optional.
